# Integers

The signed and unsigned integer types from 8 to 512 bits, the pointer-sized [`int`](/docs/api/core/integers#int) and [`uint`](/docs/api/core/integers#uint), and the [`byte`](/docs/api/core/integers#byte) alias, with their width and limit constants.

<h2 id="byte"><code>byte</code></h2>

```rux
pub type byte = uint8
```

The default alias of uint8.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Primitives/Byte.rux#L7)

<h2 id="int"><code>int</code></h2>

```rux
pub intrinsic type int;
```

A target pointer-sized signed integer.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Primitives/Int.rux#L7)

**Constants**
